## Summary

This is a **Maven** Spring Boot REST app (Spring PetClinic REST). Build tool: Maven via the `./mvnw` wrapper (no Gradle files present; `pom.xml` at repo root).

The key thing to know up front: the membership-tier rule currently implements only **SILVER** and **BRONZE** — there is **no GOLD logic anywhere in production code**, even though an acceptance test expects GOLD for a 3+ member household. Details below.

---

### 1. Where `membershipTier` is assigned (BRONZE/SILVER rules)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`

- Line 24: the DTO mapping wires the tier: `@Mapping(target = "membershipTier", expression = "java(membershipTier(owner))")`
- Lines 50-57: the actual rule.

```java
50  default String membershipTier(Owner owner) {
51      if (owner == null) {
52          return null;
53      }
54      boolean noNamesakes = owner.getNamesakeCount() != null && owner.getNamesakeCount() == 0;
55      boolean hasEmail = owner.getEmail() != null && !owner.getEmail().isBlank();
56      return noNamesakes && hasEmail ? "SILVER" : "BRONZE";
57  }
```

Only `"SILVER"` and `"BRONZE"` are ever produced. There is no `"GOLD"` branch and no household-size check here. `namesakeCount` (an input to this rule) is computed at creation time in the controller — `countNamesakes(...)` at lines 388-393 of `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`, set on line 123.

### 2. The Owner entity and its fields (incl. `householdId`)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` (extends `Person`)

Fields (lines 38-67): `address`, `city`, `telephone`, `email`, `registrationDate` (line 55), `customerCode` (line 58), **`householdId`** (lines 60-61, `@Column(name = "household_id") private String householdId;`), `namesakeCount` (lines 63-64), and `pets`. Getter/setter for householdId at lines 117-123. Note there is **no `membershipTier` field on the entity** — the tier is a derived/computed value that lives only on the DTO via the mapper.

### 3. Service class handling owner creation

Interface: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicService.java` (line 59: `void saveOwner(Owner owner)`).

Impl: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java` — lines 234-236 delegate to the repository:
```java
234  public void saveOwner(Owner owner) throws DataAccessException {
235      ownerRepository.save(owner);
236  }
```

The real creation orchestration (validation, customer code, namesake count, household assignment, tier is derived later by the mapper) is in the controller `addOwner`:
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`, lines 116-133. Relevant helpers in the same file:
- `countNamesakes` lines 388-393
- `assignHousehold` lines 532-544 (sets `householdId` when `sharesHousehold` is true)
- `householdIdFor` lines 557-572 (SHA-256 → `"HH-<16 hex>"`)
- `findHouseholdMate` / `findHouseholdMates` lines 582-605 (defines household identity: same lastName + address, case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed)

### 4. Spring Data repositories for owners

- Base interface: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java`
- Spring Data JPA impl (the `@Profile("spring-data-jpa")` one): `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/springdatajpa/SpringDataOwnerRepository.java` (extends `OwnerRepository` and Spring Data `Repository<Owner, Integer>`; custom `@Query` methods lines 39-57).
- Other profile implementations: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java` and `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jdbc/JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`.

### 5. Tests related to membership tier / owner creation

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`
- Lines 7-9 (comment `tier-gold`) describe: `membershipTier` should be `'GOLD'` when the owner's household has 3+ members after the create.
- Test `coreGoldForThreeMemberHousehold` (lines 12-29): creates 3 owners in the same household (`sharesHousehold=true`, same lastName+address) and asserts line 28: `getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.membershipTier").value("GOLD"));`

This test's expectation is **not satisfied** by the current `OwnerMapper.membershipTier` (which can only return SILVER/BRONZE) — the GOLD/household-size rule is unimplemented.

Supporting test infra (owner-creation helpers used by the test): `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` (provides `ownerNode()`, `createOwnerOk(...)`, `getOwner(...)`, `uniqueLastName()`, `uniqueAddress()`), and `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`.

### 6. Build tool and running tests

Maven with the wrapper. From `/home/daniel/sandbox`:
- Run all tests: `./mvnw test`
- Full verify (incl. integration/acceptance): `./mvnw verify`
- Run a single test class: `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest`
- Run the app: `./mvnw spring-boot:run` (per readme.md line 25)

Note (readme.md lines 195-209): some classes (DTOs like `OwnerDto`/`OwnerFieldsDto`, and MapStruct mapper impls) are **generated at build time** by Maven, so run through Maven rather than compiling files individually.
